title: The River That Remembered
author: Sovanna Idris
tagline: A ferrywoman carries a dead man's memory against the river's season.
description: Thida Vorn has ferried the dead for twenty years and never touched the river that took her daughter. When a widow hires her to carry one sealed jar upriver before the rains, she finds the water has been keeping secrets for her.
authorBio: Sovanna Idris writes about rivers, ferries and the people who work on them. She lives beside a tidal creek and keeps a small boat she rows badly.
contentNotes: Grief for a child, drowning, and political violence.
